name: Piotr Müller - Après le § 63 - Am 24
title: REPORT on public procurement
part_text: B. whereas the 2014 reform aimed to simplify procedures, enhance the participation of small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and integrate strategic procurement objectives, such as social and environmental aims, yet challenges remain in efficiency, access to data and streamlining enforcement, as well as in ensuring that public procurement fosters quality jobs and promotes collective bargaining;
